title: Gateway key lookup: record the confirmed cause and timestamp misses
intent: ARCHITECTURE.md and modules/gateway.nix state the locked-keybag (ock ACL) cause as confirmed and CPU load as unconfirmed; secretspec-gateway.log gains a timestamp per miss so future misses can be matched to lock events
proof_hooks: a forced miss writes one timestamped 'miss' line per failed attempt
a successful lookup returns the key and writes nothing
